description: Record a visit with a surgeon on the rep's account: a case covered, a meeting, a call, an in-service or a meal, on a date (default today), with an optional short note and the facility's CCN. Shared with the rep's team as customers are. Notes that read like patient information are refused with the reason; a meal comes back with a reminder about Open Payments reporting. Use when the rep tells you about a visit, after reading back what you will save.

facility.description: The hospital or ASC's six-character CCN, when the visit was there (search finds it).

note.description: What happened, without any patient information.

npi.description: 10-digit NPI; use search to find it.

on.description: The day, YYYY-MM-DD; default today. Not in the future.

outcome.description: How it went, when the rep says: a good conversation, they want a trial, not now, they are on a competitor, or no access. The answer says what to offer next.

name: log_visit
title: Log a visit
